svg.title: Figure 5 | Adjust Attention Scores
svg.desc: Values are fixed at 2 and 6. This static diagram shows default scores [1, 0], weights about 73.1% and 26.9%, and a weighted result about 3.076. The interactive tool illustrates arithmetic weighting, not execution of a real model, vectors or scaled dot products.
